text: Musikari Nazi Kombo (born March 13, 1944) is a Kenyan politician who serves as a nominated Member of Parliament. He was born in Bungoma District and completed his primary education at Misikhu Primary School, Rakwaro Primary School, and Mumias. He then attended Nyeri High School for secondary education and pursued undergraduate studies in economics at the University of Nairobi. Kombo was first elected as a Member of Parliament for Webuye Constituency in 1992. He served in the Government as Assistant Minister for Planning and Minister for Regional Development and assumed the role of Minister of Local Government in late 2003. He lost his parliamentary seat in the 2007 general election to Alfred Sambu, the Orange Democratic Movement (ODM) candidate. As of June 2015, he is the Chairman of FORD-Kenya. Kombo belongs to the larger Luhya community, specifically the Bukusu sub-tribe Balunda clan, which traces its ancestry to Mulunda, believed to have migrated from East Africa to Congo. He practices Catholicism.
